name: PDZ
recent: PDZ Holdings 提议削减 RM65,400,000 的已发行股本，以抵消累计亏损，并将在 2026 年 12 月 3 日召开 EGM 寻求股东批准。公司也将在同日召开第 30 届 AGM。最近财报显示截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度转亏为盈，营收环比和同比均增长。
notable: 提议削减 RM65,400,000 的已发行股本，以抵消累计亏损。
将于 2026 年 12 月 3 日召开 EGM 寻求股东批准资本削减。
截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度转亏为盈，净利 RM3.759 million。
risks: 资本削减仍需股东和监管批准，存在不确定性。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度，营收为 RM2.769 million，环比增长 9.1%，同比增长 55.4%；净利为 RM3.759 million，净利率 135.8%，相比上一季度的 -12.5% 转亏为盈。

recent_en: PDZ Holdings proposes a RM65,400,000 capital reduction to eliminate accumulated losses and will seek shareholder approval at an EGM on 3 Dec 2026. The latest quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 showed a turnaround to profit with revenue growing both QoQ and YoY.
notable_en: Proposed capital reduction of RM65,400,000 to eliminate accumulated losses.
EGM to be held on 3 Dec 2026 to seek shareholder approval for the capital reduction.
Turned profitable in the quarter ended 30 June 2026 with net income of RM3.759 million.
risks_en: The capital reduction is subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals, with uncertainty.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM2.769 million, up 9.1% QoQ and 55.4% YoY; net income was RM3.759 million with a net margin of 135.8%, turning around from -12.5% in the previous quarter.
